about_the_game:
Welcome to Hollowroot, a fast-paced 2D action roguelike.

Prepare to explore cave systems where danger and opportunity lurk around every corner. You'll need to fight your way through cunning traps and hostile creatures, constantly adapting to layouts that change with each descent. Every run offers its own set of surprises, potential hidden routes, and demands tight, skill-based platforming to survive.

🔑 Key Features

  • Action-focused platforming: Experience responsive movement, combat, and gameplay that keeps you on your toes with quick decisions.

  • Procedural levels: No two runs are ever quite the same; the world shifts, requiring you to master the flow and the challenges presented.

  • Roguelike mechanics: Face the permanence of defeat, embrace the unpredictability of randomized elements, and make meaningful item choices that shape your path in that specific run.

  • Stylized pixel art: Navigate through clean visuals creating a moody, atmospheric underground world.

If you appreciate challenging platforming and the rewarding loop of roguelike progression – diving in, adapting quickly, and seeing how much further you can get each time – Hollowroot might be the descent you're looking for.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 and above
  • Processor: Dual-core CPU, 2.0 GHz or better (Intel Core 2 Duo / AMD Athlon II)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU with DirectX 10 support (Intel HD 3000 or better)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Quad-core CPU, 2.5+ GHz (Intel i3/i5 or Ryzen 3+)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon HD 7770 or better)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: A fast-paced 2D roguelike where every run dives deeper — dash, fight, and adapt through corrupted caves.
